proof: Work on the effective range.  If the effective VC radius is $d$, every $d$-subset is shattered.  For each coordinate order, the relevant initial $d$-set is therefore order-shattered by the downshifting characterization.  Thus every order has an order-shattered set of size $d$, and minimizing over orders gives $\mathrm{OSH}_{\min}(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal H)$.
name: Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set / Effective VC Radius
